## Social organization transmits changed rules

**共同工作 → 参与及授权关系 → 程序修订 → 分化后的实际接续 → 不同的后续筛选。** Following [Ren's social/organizational direction](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-social-organizational-evolution.md), the [existing study continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EVOLUTIONARY-ORGANIZATION-INTEGRATION.md#organizational-rules-become-inheritable) now establishes this connection in a declared institutional protocol. It begins with ongoing work and retained reviews; office formation requires those relations and current authorization. A proposed rule does not become operative until its actual adoption. Successors retain the enacted rule and record, while their continuing participation is checked separately.

The revised procedure permits an additional kind of technical decision: two distinct supporters, a completed interval and no eligible opposition. The source and its branch may coexist and share participants. Later admitted activity retains the rule until another authorized adoption changes it. An actual constructed history joins formation, adoption, two handoffs and two permitted integrations. Empty participation defeats execution despite a copied charter. With only two continuing officeholders, technical decisions can remain possible while the higher governance threshold prevents further rule revision. **能继续运作，不等于仍能改变自身的组织方式。**

The [29-theorem / 53-new-audit verification](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/organizational-rule-inheritance-verification/README.md) has 81 audits in its actual two-module closure. This is a procedural model: seed mandate, recognition, copying, proposal content, compliance and the higher amendment rule remain supplied. Accepted decisions are counted; execution or quality of software changes is not modeled. The [primary source packet](../../../sources/evolutionary-selection/organizational-inheritance/README.md) separates actual Valkey reorganization and governance revision, TDF coordination, and strong routine/replication theory from the illustrative handoff history. Its limits include incomplete procedural-compliance evidence and no causal productivity estimate.

This completes a conditional social mechanism for inherited organizing variation and its effects on subsequent procedural selection. The next connection is how those actual consequences change continued participation, recruitment and later adoption or abandonment of the organizing rule. A conventional process model given the same enacted relations yields the same result; comparative superiority and favorable ethical direction do not follow.

**社会组织规则的可继承变化 / Inherited organizational rule change，2026-10-08。** C14接续[既有组织研究](EVOLUTIONARY-ORGANIZATION-INTEGRATION.md#organizational-rules-become-inheritable)：29项新定理／53项新审计／81项实际闭包审计；共同工作形成资格，授权修订后的程序进入分化后的实际接续，复制与参与分别保留。/ Only owned C14 additions, paired links and read source versions change. Primary organizational records, incomplete compliance evidence and a strong conventional comparator are explicit. [Owned edits](ORGANIZATIONAL-RULE-INDEX-EDITS.json) and [checks](ORGANIZATIONAL-RULE-CHECKS.json) preserve other entries and the six full-theory requirements.

six_requirement_rows: | **1 Formation of evolving organization** | Formation, regulation and developmental reconstruction have conditional models. The new bond-history account derives common founder ancestry under local non-aggregative development, with a targeted biological correspondence. | Extend the connected explanation beyond the stated local laws, retaining genealogy, actual construction and empirical scope. Origins of cells/genomes and broader mechanisms are not established by this case. |

| **2 Recovery of established evolutionary explanations** | Explicit transmission models and the new two-type recurrence correspondence. | Correspondences covering the claimed selection, mutation, drift, movement, inheritance and ecological mechanisms, with valid ranges and failures. Mathematical claims require actual Lean checks. An abstract interface alone is insufficient. |

| **3 Evolution of the conditions of evolution** | Actual output determines reconstruction, and inherited retention changes development. Retention, packing and aggregation constrain sorting. A bacterial genealogy and directly linked reversion assay now connect inherited switching to actual cycle completion and subsequent lineage representation under a declared regime. Separate oxygen experiments establish activity-generated gradients and condition-dependent competitive outcomes. | Generalize and calibrate these connections with supported renewal, mixing and stochastic occurrence. Resolve the separate yeast census conversion and follow fragmentation/aggregation participants. Explain mutation, transmission and replacement contributions to prevalence; fixation alone is not causal proof. Laboratory protocol changes do not establish endogenous evolution of the selector. |

| **4 Novel organization and changed evolutionary units** | The completed [new-possibilities integration](NEW-POSSIBILITIES.md) distinguishes installed construction from encompassing law, gives a formed constructor and scope-specific description revision. The association model adds formed group relations; empirical aggregation distinguishes temporary sorting groups from inherited organizations. | Credit those results and connect formation to inherited retention and ongoing effect under actual evolutionary conditions. Common transport does not alone establish a new inherited unit. Broader changes of evolutionary units and sustained qualitative innovation require their own mechanisms and evidence. |

| **5 Demonstrated comparative strength** | Exact recurrence correspondence and a proved limit of snapshots omitting bonds. Retention data compare ordinary predictors with/without protocol information, including a worsening case. A source-bound settling sensitivity holds geometry fixed and reveals consequential density/drag choices; a conventional developmental life-cycle model receives credit. Chronological genealogy forecasts now demonstrate a gain over a changing stage average and two block alternatives, fully credited to conventional lineage inference. Dated assay transfer exposes stage-specific prediction failures. | Establish a consequential gain against an adequately specified rival with matched evidence and assumptions. Neither the reduced baselines nor disagreement between unvalidated velocity approximations establishes superior prediction. Measure sorting and descendants to decide the physical correspondence. Broad empirical superiority remains unestablished. |

| **6 Ethical continuation and evolved evaluation** | The [practical-judgment candidate](PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT.md) is complete and independently accepted at its explicit-axiom general-principles scope, with G0 and additional comparison/responsibility commitments disclosed. | Credit that completed scope; connect evolved evaluation to its actual recognition, calibration and implementation, preserving failures. Application correspondence and actual compliance require evidence. Reproductive advantage cannot silently serve as ethical authority. |
